title: Probability Theory (TUM, Modul MA2409)
description: Independence of sigma-algebras and random variables, existence of sequences of random variables, Kolmogorov's extension theorem, Borel-Cantelli lemmas, Kolmogorov's 0-1-law, weak and strong law of large numbers, characteristic functions, weak convergence, central limit theorem for L²-random variables, Lindeberg-Feller. Conditional expectations. Martingales: inequalities, convergence theorems, optional stopping theorem.
